about.title: An engineering practice where code, fire and city management meet.
body: I graduated from Hacettepe University in Computer Engineering in 2005 and joined the Ankara Metropolitan Municipality Fire Department in 2008. Nearly a decade of firefighting followed: building teams, running operations and carrying decision responsibility in emergencies.

In 2018 I moved to ASKI, the city's water and wastewater utility. In the branch-management and department-head years of the ASKİ career that started as a programmer and project manager, water and wastewater infrastructure, operational transformation and digitalisation were at the centre of the agenda. I also spent long hours on various cybersecurity and performance tuning efforts. Today I serve as a Senior Specialist at ASKI.
Software continued alongside all of this. İPEK Baca CRM and SimaLogistic SaaS emerged from turning field needs directly into product.
